alerts.title: Next water turn Wednesday 18 Nov
alerts.why: Wheat is emerging. Soil at 88%, above the 50% refill point. No rain in the forecast.
steps: Water on your turn Wednesday, early morning.
Make sure water reaches the nw corner.
alerts.voice: الأرض فيها مية كفاية لحد دورك يوم الأربع.

alerts.title: Little rust weather this week
alerts.why: 0 of the last 7 nights were foggy and humid. Nights 11 to 15 °C. Your variety can catch rust, so keep watching.
steps: From January, walk the field once a week.
alerts.source: Rust weather index, NASA POWER and Open-Meteo humidity and dew point

alerts.title: New satellite image: the nw corner looks weaker
alerts.why: The nw corner is 12% less green than the rest, two images in a row.
alerts.voice: فيه حتة في الأرض أضعف من الباقي. روح بص عليها.

alerts.title: Weeding starts around 29 Nov
alerts.why: Weeks 3 to 6 after sowing are the critical weed-free period for wheat sown 8 Nov.
steps: Hoe or hand weed before fertilizing.
alerts.voice: نضّف الأرض من الحشايش لحد يوم 20.

alerts.title: No heat risk this week
alerts.why: Highs of 26 to 28 °C. Wheat is not yet at a heat sensitive stage.
